fact: Customs says the SYDONIA World platform is used by Central African Republic customs, and Cameroon's CAMCIS is to be made interoperable with it.

The Minister of Finance and Budget says the Sydonia World application was implemented at the General Directorate of Customs and Indirect Duties on 1 February 2022 to dematerialise clearance procedures.
The Ministry of Finance and Budget's proposed 2025 budget carries a line of XAF 115,000,000 titled 'Appui au deploiement de SYDONIA World', supporting the rollout of the customs system.
The finance ministry says FCFA 3.28 billion of France's budget-support convention signed 13 November 2024 is earmarked to reforms including the implementation of SYDONIA World.

Investir en Centrafrique reports that, once the DPI fee is paid via Orange Money, the loading-intention declaration is generated automatically and data goes in real time to the SYDONIA customs system, on the eDouanes platform run by concessionaire Webb Fontaine.

Africa24 reports Central African customs officers processing cargo on the computer through Sydonia World at M'poko airport and the Bangui dry port, with declarations handled in real time per the dry-port head.
Africa24 reports Bangui customs officials working declarations in Sydonia World, which gives access to declarations in all offices including those entered at the single office.
